flags.title: SSH posture changed
flags.description: A change to SSH daemon/client configuration that may affect access control, ciphers, or operator workflow.

flags.title: Boot chain drift
flags.description: Firmware/boot chain version changed (UEFI/BIOS/BMC). Treat as high leverage and reviewable drift.

flags.title: Trust roots changed
flags.description: Trust roots / Secure Boot / platform trust anchors changed; often requires explicit approvals and provenance verification.

flags.title: Kernel lockdown changed
flags.description: Kernel posture/lockdown policy changed via sysctl plan drift.

flags.title: Kernel posture drift
flags.description: Kernel security posture changed (capability boundaries, module policy, or other high-leverage knobs).

flags.title: Kernel module runtime loading enabled
flags.description: The kernel module policy now allows runtime module loading after activation (increases privileged code injection surface).

flags.title: Kernel module policy rule added
flags.description: A new allow/deny rule was added to the kernel module policy. Review the module class and match scope.

flags.title: Kernel module policy rule removed
flags.description: An allow/deny rule was removed from the kernel module policy. Treat removals as potentially broadening posture unless proven otherwise.

flags.title: New network egress
flags.description: A sandbox profile gained new outbound network egress.

flags.title: Sandbox gained filesystem execute
flags.description: A sandbox profile gained the ability to execute files from a filesystem surface.

flags.title: New portal surface
flags.description: A sandbox or broker gained a new portal surface (new entrypoint capability).

flags.title: Preopen map gained network egress
flags.description: A Capsicum preopen map gained a new inet socket handle (new outbound egress surface).

flags.title: Preopen map gained a new handle
flags.description: A Capsicum preopen map gained a new handle label/target (new authority grant).

flags.title: Preopen map rights broadened
flags.description: A Capsicum preopen map broadened descriptor rights (e.g., read-only to read/write).

flags.title: Raw blobs enabled
flags.description: Export policy allows raw blobs (potential sensitive data exfiltration).

flags.title: Consent relaxed
flags.description: Export or privileged operation consent posture was relaxed (e.g. two-person to single).

flags.title: New external recipient
flags.description: Export policy added a new external recipient class/identifier.

flags.title: Transparency required
flags.description: Export policy requires publishing transparency evidence for exports.

flags.title: New trust anchor
flags.description: Trust bundle added a new root/anchor.

flags.title: Constraints expanded
flags.description: Trust constraints broadened (e.g., name constraints expanded).

flags.title: Name constraints broadened
flags.description: Trust bundle name constraints broadened.

flags.title: Trust policy drift
flags.description: Trust policy changed (accepted signer roles/keys, required attestations, or channel rollback/expiry posture). Treat as high leverage and reviewable drift.

flags.title: Policy module changed
flags.description: A signed policy evaluation module changed. Treat as high leverage: behavior and decision posture may change.

flags.title: Policy module hostcalls expanded
flags.description: The policy module declared new hostcalls (authority surface expanded). Treat as critical posture drift.

flags.title: Policy module limits relaxed
flags.description: Policy evaluation resource limits were relaxed (fuel/memory). This can hide expensive policies or widen denial-of-service risk.

flags.title: Bootloader/loader changed
flags.description: Boot-critical loader/shim/config drift (loader, shim, or bootloader-config) detected in boot manifest diff.

flags.title: Kernel image changed
flags.description: Kernel digest drift detected in boot manifest diff.

flags.title: Kernel cmdline/profile changed
flags.description: Kernel cmdline profile digest drift detected in boot manifest diff (may change sandbox posture or boot-time knobs).

flags.title: New time source added
flags.description: Time-source allowlist added a new authenticated time source (review for operator class, trust root, and expected behavior).

flags.title: Time source removed
flags.description: Time-source allowlist removed a source (may reduce redundancy or quorum resilience).

flags.title: Time source changed
flags.description: An existing time source changed endpoint/protocol/parameters (review for expected routing and trust).

flags.title: Time source trust root changed
flags.description: A time source's trust root / pubkey bundle digest changed; treat as high-leverage time authority drift.

flags.title: Time quorum relaxed
flags.description: Quorum policy weakened (e.g. fewer sources required or larger max skew), reducing confidence in timestamps.

flags.title: Time bootstrap relaxed
flags.description: Bootstrap rules weakened (e.g. RTC allowed, larger forward/backward jumps), increasing rollback-by-clock risk.

flags.title: Attestation admission policy drift
flags.description: Attestation admission policy changed (what actions are gated, for which selectors, and by which requirement digests).

flags.title: Admission rule added
flags.description: A new (action, selector) admission rule was added to the attestation admission policy.

flags.title: Admission rule removed
flags.description: An existing (action, selector) admission rule was removed. This may weaken or remove gating for a sensitive action.

flags.title: Admission requirement changed
flags.description: An admission rule's requirement digest changed; this may tighten or weaken which posture is required for an action.

flags.title: Bundle scope expanded
flags.description: Bundle selection scope expanded (larger time window and/or larger max bytes). Treat as higher exfil risk and reviewable drift.

flags.title: Coredumps included in bundles
flags.description: A bundle plan enabled coredump inclusion. Coredumps may contain secrets; treat as high-risk export posture drift.

flags.title: Trace/replay capsules included in bundles
flags.description: A bundle plan enabled trace/replay capsule inclusion. Capsules may contain sensitive execution context; require explicit authorization and review.

flags.title: Redaction transform changed
flags.description: A bundle plan changed the bound deterministic redaction transform digest. Review for privacy/compliance and ensure policy intent matches receipts.

flags.title: Export policy binding changed
flags.description: A bundle plan changed the bound export policy digest (recipient/consent/encryption constraints). Treat as high-leverage egress drift.

flags.title: Verified execution disabled
flags.description: Verified execution mode changed to disabled (no runtime integrity enforcement for exec/load).

flags.title: Verified execution enforcement relaxed
flags.description: Verified execution enforcement relaxed (e.g., enforce→audit or audit→disabled), reducing runtime integrity guarantees.

flags.title: Verified execution exception added
flags.description: An explicit verified-exec exception was added (path allowlisted outside the derived fingerprint set). Exceptions should be time-bounded and tied to decision records.

flags.title: Adapter enabled
flags.description: An adapter lane moved from disabled to an active mode (adapter/shadow/replace). Treat as interop posture drift with supply-chain and boundary implications.

flags.title: Adapter entered shadow mode
flags.description: An adapter lane entered shadow mode (side-by-side). Expect comparison receipts and treat as a deliberate migration step.

flags.title: Adapter entered replace mode
flags.description: An adapter lane entered replace mode (adapter path on the critical path). Treat as a cutover with bounded deprecation/removal plan.

flags.title: Adapter scope broadened
flags.description: An adapter gained broader allowed scopes (especially import→runtime). Treat as authority/trust-boundary expansion.

flags.title: Default adapter posture relaxed
flags.description: Default adapter posture for unknown ids relaxed away from deny-by-default. This risks ambient interop and should be exceptional.

flags.title: Impurity waiver added
flags.description: A new impurity waiver was added (explicitly allowing known non-determinism/impurity). Waivers should be narrow, time-bounded, and evidence-bound.

flags.title: Impurity waiver extended
flags.description: An impurity waiver expiry was extended. Treat repeated extensions as policy debt and require an explicit removal plan.

flags.title: Impurity waiver scope broadened
flags.description: An impurity waiver grew in applicability scope (more profiles/lanes/stages/targets). Treat as reproducibility posture drift.

flags.title: Default impurity posture relaxed
flags.description: Default impurity waiver policy posture relaxed away from deny-by-default. This risks ambient impurity and should be exceptional.

flags.title: Raw disk devices exposed in /dev view
flags.description: A devfs view change exposes raw storage devices (e.g. da*/ada*/nvd*). This is extremely high leverage authority and should be exceptional.

flags.title: Packet capture device nodes exposed
flags.description: A devfs view change exposes packet capture device nodes (e.g. bpf*). Prefer brokered/portal-only capture where possible.

flags.title: Input/HID device nodes exposed
flags.description: A devfs view change exposes input/HID-related device nodes. This can enable data exfiltration or injection and should be tightly controlled.

flags.title: Devfs permissions relaxed
flags.description: A devfs view change broadened permissions or ownership on one or more device nodes. Review for unintended authority expansion.
